description:
Search skills on AI Skill Store. Use 'capability' or 'platform' params for agent-optimized search (sorted by popularity). Returns skill name, description, downloads, rating, and trust level. / AI Skill Store에서 스킬 검색.
    capability나 platform을 지정하면 에이전트 최적화 검색(인기순 정렬)을 사용합니다.

    Args:
        query: 검색 키워드 (스킬 이름 또는 설명). 비워두면 전체 목록.
        capability: 능력 태그로 검색 (예: web_search, text_summarization, code_generation)
        platform: 특정 플랫폼 호환 스킬만 (OpenClaw, ClaudeCode, ClaudeCodeAgentSkill, Cursor, GeminiCLI, CodexCLI)
        min_trust: 최소 신뢰 등급 (verified > community > sandbox)
        category: 카테고리 필터 (에이전트 검색 미사용 시에만 적용)
        sort: 정렬 기준 (에이전트 검색 미사용 시에만: newest | downloads | rating)
        limit: 결과 수 (기본 20, 최대 50)

    Returns:
        스킬 목록 문자열

capability.description: Capability tag for agent-optimized search (sorted by popularity), e.g. web_search, text_summarization, code_generation.
capability.title: Capability

category.description: Category filter, e.g. 'Development' or 'Data Processing' (see list_categories). Applied only when capability/platform/min_trust are NOT used.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1-50 (agent search caps at 50). Default 20.
limit.title: Limit

min_trust.description: Minimum trust level, one of: verified | community | sandbox (verified is the highest). Empty means no filter.
min_trust.title: Min Trust

platform.description: Only return skills compatible with this platform. One of: OpenClaw | ClaudeCode | ClaudeCodeAgentSkill | CodexCLI | Cursor | GeminiCLI | CustomAgent.
platform.title: Platform

query.description: Free-text keyword matched against skill name and description, e.g. 'pdf summarizer'. Empty string lists all skills.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Sort order, one of: newest | downloads | rating. Applied only when capability/platform/min_trust are NOT used.
sort.title: Sort

name: search_skills
